content: Funnel analytics: emit stage transition events (funnel.stage_entered) with event payload {stage, variant_id, user_id, session_id}. Drop-off rate = 1 - (stage_N_completed / stage_N_entered). A/B test variant assignment: use crypto.createHash('sha256').update(user_id + experiment_id + salt).digest('hex') mod variant_count for consistent hashing (same user always gets same variant). Track conversion with funnel.completed event. Store funnel definitions in analytics_funnel_definitions table.
